data.name: Blessings of Khorne
units: Vorrakh, Lord of the Frenzied Reavers
data.summary: If your Army Faction is WORLD EATERS, at each battle-round start you may roll 8D6 and allocate dice to up to two different Blessings. Each may be activated only once that round; discard unused dice. Benefits last that battle round for units with this ability. • Unbridled Bloodlust (any double): +1 Charge. • Rage-Fuelled Invigoration (double 2+): Pile-in and Consolidation up to 6″ instead of 3″. • Total Carnage (double 3+): a model destroyed by a melee attack that has not fought this phase fights after the attacker finishes on a 4+, then is removed. • Martial Excellence (double 4+ or any triple): melee Sustained Hits 1. • Warp Blades (double 5+ or triple 2+): melee Lethal Hits. • Decapitating Strikes (double 6+ or triple 3+): melee attacks against INFANTRY gain Devastating Wounds. Dice spent on one Blessing cannot also pay for another. This is the separately scoped Frenzied Reavers record; do not grant it to other units merely by name. Source review: the Combat Patrol Total Carnage import lacks the ordinary melee-destruction restriction; confirm that variant’s full wording.

Each model has one use per turn and each Ritual one army use per turn. Destiny’s Ruin (warp charge 5) marks a visible enemy within 24″ for friendly THOUSAND SONS/SCINTILLATING LEGIONS Hit re-rolls of 1, or full Hit re-rolls on 10+, for the phase. Temporal Surge (6) gives one visible unengaged friendly unit of either faction within 24″ a D6″ Normal move, or 6″ on 10+, with no charge that turn. Doombolt (7) deals D3 mortal wounds to a visible enemy within 24″, or D3+3 on 11+; an unattached Lone Operative must be within 12″. Twist of Fate (9) improves friendly models’ AP against a visible enemy within 24″ by 1 for the phase, or 2 on 12+. Check the incompletely specified extra-die and doubles/triples procedure before resolving Channelling.

data.name: Cult Ambush
data.summary: Combat Patrol starts with 2 Resurgence points. When a unit is destroyed and every model has Cult Ambush, spend 2 points to replace a five-model Claw of Ascension Atalan Jackals or Hybrid Metamorphs unit at full Starting Strength and wounds, with One Shot weapons refreshed, in Cult Ambush. No cost is listed for Shanus or the Ridgerunner; this does not permit replacing them or attached Characters. Place a 32mm marker more than 9″ horizontally from enemies, or no marker if impossible. An enemy non-AIRCRAFT model ending any move within 8″ removes the marker. At the end of the opponent’s next Movement phase, each surviving marker can bring in one Cult Ambush unit: one model touches the marker, every other model is wholly within 3″, then remove the marker. Normal ingress placement and enemy reserve-denial restrictions still apply. This can arrive in round 1. Cult Ambush is Strategic Reserves: no Rapid Ingress and no automatic round-three destruction; normal Strategic Reserves arrival in a subsequent turn is another option. These are the Combat Patrol costs and 9″ placement rule, not the ordinary army table.
